Fix Steps: Check that the Header selected in the panel is registered on DLT with the exact spelling (case-sensitive). / The Header status on DLT must be Active (not Inactive / Suspended / Blacklisted). / The Header must be linked with the template - verify the template details on DLT. / Select the correct Header and send again.

Meaning: The SMS contains a link but no URL / CTA is whitelisted on DLT.
Fix Steps: First get your URL whitelisted (CTA) on the DLT portal (Jio / Airtel / Vi / BSNL) - only then will the SMS go through. / Use exactly the URL that was whitelisted in the SMS / template (if it is a short link or landing page link, get that exact link whitelisted). / The template text must match the text approved on DLT. / Send the SMS again after whitelisting. If it still fails, mail support1@nimbusitsolutions.com with the Error Code, URL and Template ID.
